title: The trainer’s plan and the client’s log
description: Hand over the program, see the sets that were done, and discuss changes in one place.

blocks.text: A trainer moving client work online needs a workflow of their own: hand over the plan, see what was done and discuss changes. That is a different job from choosing a ready-made course.

quote.text: When I decided to take my fit business online I had no clue how to do it. Trainerize made it so easy and simple.

blocks.text: Continue the plan through the client’s log

The trainer assigns the program, the client marks the sets actually done and leaves a question on an exercise. A change to the next session is visible to both sides, along with its date and reason. Access is limited to the data the client chose.
Look at where a trainer today forwards spreadsheets, loses comments or asks for a result twice. A workspace is useful if it cuts that work down; another video library does not replace it.
